latin: Prima trinitas manet tantum, secunda manet et procedit, tertia post processum conuertit.
translation: The first triad only remains; the second remains and goes forth; the third, once it has gone forth, turns back.
translation_note: The three verbs are the Proclean remaining, procession and reversion ('manet, procedit, conuertit'). No further crux.
